decisions.rationale: Silver birch, re-cooked from W0 with a middle level of detail: a slender white trunk with dark marks and a light crown of small leaf cards; 2 variants 13.5-15.5 m tall; at most 507 triangles near, 103 in the middle level of detail and a 6-triangle impostor; 134,360 bytes before meshopt. Parts, triangle budget and impostor checked by the world-assets suite; baked AO.
limitations: Two variants only; every birch's bark has the same tiling marks.

decisions.rationale: In the Heartlands, Fenlands, Crownlands and Salt Coast woods and the Greenmarch, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at natural scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss (trees are not scaled up), with shadows on the ground. Distance bands: near parts to 24 m (spruce, birch and oaks have a middle level there), the middle level to 58 m and impostors to 235 m; the canopy cutaway cone (3-6 m at the hero, twice that at the camera) keeps the hero visible inside the forest.
limitations: Card foliage reads flat and dark where a tree stands beside the camera at mid-distance; the sightline cone keeps the hero and the ground round them clear.
